shared_elements: low relief carving on a vertical stone surface
horizontal registers/bands of imagery stacked one above another
a row of repeated similar figures within a band
band of repeated small geometric/linear motifs
justification: Both surfaces divide their field into stacked horizontal registers, each containing a row of repeated figures, and both include profile animals alongside anthropomorphic forms — but these are generic organising devices. A shows a naturalistic, densely packed procession of clothed human tribute-bearers with a hoofed animal, rendered with modelled anatomy and drapery, whereas B shows isolated, highly schematic animals (a crouching quadruped, a bird with long neck, a snake-like form) and abstract H-shaped and looped signs on a T-shaped pillar, with no human procession and no interaction between figures.
